title: ETH Top-Ups for Erin
brief: Erin runs the treasury's bots and needs small ETH top-ups now and then. The owners want to send her plain ETH, as often as needed, and nothing else: no contract calls, nothing attached to the payment.

tests.label: Send 0.5 ETH to Erin with four zero bytes attached

hints: A plain ETH payment has nothing attached. Its rule names Erin, with the action "Send ETH".
Four zero bytes attached land on the same rule as nothing attached. Always Allow cannot tell them apart.
Plain ETH Transfer on Erin, action "Send ETH".
explain: Nothing attached and four zero bytes attached look the same to the rulebook, so they share Erin's rule. Always Allow lets both through, and sent to a contract, those bytes could run its code. Plain ETH Transfer checks that nothing is attached, that it is a normal call and that some ETH moves.
